{{Top|leg}}
'''Energy swords''' were used by very elderly [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for ceremonies. [[Jax Pavan]], a private investigator and former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], briefly used [[Jax Pavan's Velmorian energy sword|one]] as a replacement for his destroyed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. [[Velmorian energy sword]]s were also used for ceremonies and duels on the planet Velmor.
